text: {"assertions":["A spurious 429 error issue was discovered in api/gateway/rate_limit.go affecting only accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The root cause of the spurious 429 errors was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The spurious 429 issue could be reproduced by replaying a saved burst fixture.","Throttle counters reading far above the configured ceiling was the observable signal of the spurious 429 problem.","The fix involved prefetching the lazy relation in a single query instead of allowing N+1 queries.","Memory usage improved from climbing past 6 GB to settling at 206 MB after the fix was applied.","The spurious 429 fix was implemented in PR #1800 on branch fix/spurious-429-1.","The fix work was in the same area of code as earlier spurious 429 investigations, allowing prior context to carry over."]}
